en: Black‑and‑white view of a landscaped park with a pond in the foreground, reeds and several swans on the water, and a small hexagonal pavilion or gazebo on an islet. In the background stand two large brick institutional buildings with ornate facades, gables and arched windows, connected by a curving path lined with a low fence. Mature trees surround the scene, suggesting a peaceful estate or hospital complex from the early 20th century.
